summary: New CI gate `pnpm check:utilities`, wired into verify. It asserts that every themed Tailwind utility used in registry/ resolves to a variable the token theme actually emits. This closes the quietest failure mode in a token-bound library: a utility naming a token that does not exist produces NO css at all — types cannot see it (strings), lint cannot see it (valid syntax), and review cannot see it (only shows on the state that is broken). Proven by probe: a one-character typo in a hover utility fails the gate. The gate stays dependency-free like its siblings, so a cold clone can run it.

migration.manual: None. Component authors get a failing gate instead of a silently dead state.
